Method new()

Usage

RamigaFloppyDrive$new(emulator, drive_number = 0)

Arguments

emulator

An RamigaEmulator class object. The floppy drive to be created needs to be associated with a virtual machine. The initiated object will represent the floppy drive of the emulated machine.

drive_number

The emulator has 4 floppy drives, numbered 0 to 3. Pick which drive you want to operate

Method insert_disk()

Insert a virtual floppy disk in the virtual floppy drive.

Usage

RamigaFloppyDrive$insert_disk(disk, write_protected = TRUE)

Arguments

disk

A floppy disk represented by a RamigaImage class object.

write_protected

logical value indicating whether the inserted disk needs to be write protected. Default is TRUE

Method eject_disk()

Eject a virtual floppy disk from the virtual drive

Usage

delay
